findings.reason: In steps 5.1–6.1, X=|ν−ν′|/α and the action correction is divided by α, but the claimed lower-Lipschitz estimate for the physical map uses no defined scaled output norm. The base action difference divided by α gives the stated uniform bound; in unscaled phase coordinates it gives only an α-dependent bound, so the error comparison and subsequent null-set argument do not establish positive phase-space measure as written. The local repair is to define the scaled map (p,θ)↦(p/α,θ), prove the lower-Lipschitz estimate there, then transfer null sets through the invertible scaling for each fixed α. Steps 5.1 and 6.1 are affected; the checked downstream consumers use the label-measure and torus conclusions, not this added phase-space-measure claim.
